acceptanceCriteria: The static --playwright-config profile resolves `...devices['<known name>']` to its browser identity, matching the provider path from #49; unknown or computed names stay unresolved.
A focused test fails on the pre-fix base and passes after; spec amended in the same change.
GitHub #709 part 1 answered on the merged PR.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#709 (Corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 main-02e8457). In a multi-project Playwright suite whose projects all use `use: { ...devices['Desktop Chrome'] }`, the static `corvint affected --playwright-config` profile reports playwright:browser-identity-unresolved for every project, so every shared-code change falls back to FULL_RELEVANT_SUITE (~2.5 h). #49 resolved this spread for the provider path only. Expected: the static profile resolves a spread of a known Playwright devices descriptor the same way.
title: affected --playwright-config leaves the standard ...devices['<name>'] project spread browser-identity-unresolved (GitHub #709 part 1)
